projects.title: Bankers united
projects.description:
Financial Fair, a Kosovar Bankers' Association initiative, is held every year to bring banks, financial institutions and insurance companies together, bringing them closer to their customers.

We were selected to develop the identity, promote and organize the Financial Fair 2012. This included the design of logo and identity, catalogues, brochures, agendas and other promotional material, together with the promotion of the fair in the media, billboards, posters, bicycle boards, printed media, as well as the event and space management.
